==Russian==

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|мета́ть}}

===Etymology 1===
{{root|ru|ine-pro|*met-}}
{{inh+|ru|orv|метати}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*metàti||to throw}}, from {{der|ru|ine-pro|*met-}}.

====Verb====
{{ru-verb|мета́ть|impf|pf=метну́ть}}

# to [[throw]], to [[cast]], to [[toss]]
#: {{ux|ru|[[воин|Во́ины]] '''ме́чут''' [[тяжёлый|тяжёлые]] [[копьё|ко́пья]].|The warriors are throwing heavy spears.}}
# to [[spawn]] (roe)
